5_known_CE_semantics.evidence: Two semantics coexist per contributor and per series. Verified: MassBank record CE text is free text (AC$MASS_SPECTROMETRY: COLLISION_ENERGY, exported verbatim as Collision_energy: in MassBank_NIST.msp); MassSpecGym converts only strings containing '%' as eV = NCE*precursor_mz/500 and keeps every other first number raw. Hand-verified per accession: NaToxAq NA000438 '20%' -> MSG 14.087020 = 20*352.1755/500; Eawag EA034202 '15 %' -> 19.343625; HBM4EU HB003696 '20%' -> 12.764704; Eawag EQ330851 '15 (nominal)' -> raw 15/30/45/60. Residual gap: the 2023.11 record text itself was NOT read (record .txt files carry peak lists, outside the download policy); the strings observed are 2025.10 titles and dev-HEAD AC$ lines

6_MH_positive_available.evidence: 20,091 positive-mode [M+H]+ records of 25,349 at the tag; 19,462 of them are ESI-Orbitrap-class design rows with a parseable structure

7_compatible_fragmentation_instrument.evidence: 24,929 of 25,349 records are ESI Orbitrap class (LC-ESI-ITFT 16,327, LC-ESI-QFT 8,557, ESI-ITFT 45); incompatible remainder: 299 QTOF (HBM4EU), 102 APCI, 19 records absent from the current server. Fragmentation mode at dev HEAD in a 1,570-file sample is mostly HCD but includes CID on Orbitrap: NaToxAq 71/300, HBM4EU 41/200, UFZ 6-8/200, Eawag 7/270; MassSpecGym maps LC-ESI-ITFT and LC-ESI-QFT alike to 'Orbitrap', and ms-pred's token set (chem_utils.py:277-282) has a separate IT-FT = Orbitrap CID token that MassSpecGym never uses. Records whose CE is raw NCE on an Orbitrap are the deployment-compatible subset for MURU's fixed NCE20/NCE60

8_multiple_energies_per_compound.evidence: median 7 distinct CE values per design compound (q25 6, q75 9); 1,463 of 1,639 have >= 4; ladders: NaToxAq 10-105 step 5, Eawag 15-180, Eawag_Additional_Specs 15-95, UFZ 10-125, HBM4EU 5-185, AAFC 10-55

9_structural_diversity_after_exclusions.evidence: 15 compounds / 11 scaffold groups survive key exclusion (MassSpecGym all folds + MURU registry + PR #7 + comparator); 5 compounds / 4 groups also survive scaffold-group exclusion, and 4 of those 5 have [M+H]+ > 1000 m/z (one above the MURU development range 70.0-1042.6); only 1 of the 15 has both NCE 20 and 60; 10 of 15 have >= 2 energies. Far below a scaffold-split calibration plus held-out evaluation

10_license_and_access.evidence: CC BY 4.0 14,614 records, CC0 6,980, CC BY-SA 4.0 3,736 (19 records no longer served); public GitHub repository plus public MassBank API and export service; no registration

11_hidden_MassSpecGym_inclusion_plausibl.evidence: MassBank 2023.11 is a declared MassSpecGym source, so inclusion is not hidden but certain: 1,615/1,639 by key. Of the 24 design compounds not matched by key, 12 have a formula that occurs in MassSpecGym; 4 of the 15 post-exclusion survivors have a canonical-tautomer key equal to a MassSpecGym compound's, i.e. the same chemistry is in training under a different recorded identifier

verdict.reason: criteria 1, 4, 9 and 11 fail decisively, so C03 can never serve as held-out evaluation data; its value is exactly what the candidate record claims, CE-semantics attribution per training source

disclosures: The MassBank server serves release 2025.10 (API /metadata version 2025.10, 2025-10-24); every title, license and structure read through the export service is that release, not 2023.11. The accession set screened is the 2023.11 git tree (25,349 records), 25,330 of which still exist in 2025.10 (19 UFZ records gone).
No MassBank record .txt, release asset, /records/{accession} response, peak list, model output or MURU measurement was read at any point in this screen or this verification.

One exploratory commit-diff call (fd8fb15, the 2025.10 release merge) returned patches of whole new record files added after the tag and therefore carried peak lines in memory; only a field-tag histogram was computed, nothing was stored, printed or used, and none of those records is in the screened 2023.11 set. Recorded in downloads_register.jsonl.

Post-tag change bound for CE strings: of the commits touching the six directories, only 12b1ea6 (886), 4398ef3 (1,647), 90fdf6f (569), 2d07d24 (5,574, PUBLICATION: NA) and the repo-wide release merge fd8fb15 (597) delete any line; every other commit is additions-only. For 48 sampled record files (8 per directory) the only post-tag commits touching them are ChemOnt/CHEBI metadata commits (plus one HBM4EU file in fd8fb15), and in 1,200 sampled record-file patches of those metadata commits every changed line is CH$LINK. So AC$MASS_SPECTROMETRY: COLLISION_ENERGY rewrites between 2023.11 and today are bounded to at most a few hundred lines repo-wide and none were observed.
